newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. 77,700 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,300 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was 68.00, 67.00 on lighter weight heifers, on Wednesday. Today's packer bids are 67.00 with asking prices 68.00- 69.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
